decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Planning, Design and Access statement (including energy saving calculations and noise assessment report), 4100/P3/201 Rev 2, 4100/P3/620 Rev 2, 410/P3/203 Rev 2, 4100/P3/PL2 Rev 2, 4100/P3/202 Rev 2, 4100/P3/7001 Rev 2 received on 26/01/2016 and Location Plan (4100/P3/PL1 Rev 3) received on 28/01/2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - a) The rating level of noise emitted from fixed plant on the site, shall be lower than the existing background noise level by 10dB in line with the approved noise assessment. The noise levels shall be determined at the nearest noise sensitive locations. The measurements shall be made according to BS4142:1997.
b) A commissioning acoustic test shall be undertaken within two weeks of mechanical services commissioning, in order to demonstrate condition 3a) has been achieved; The result(s) of the test shall be submitted to and approved by the LPA within four weeks of mechanical services commissioning.
Condition : 4 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant, except those shown on the approved plans, shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The acoustic louvers, piping and gantries associated with the structure hereby permitted shall match the colour of those used in the existing building.
